_area: Windsor VIC 3181 (Chapel St). Verify each id from your home network via `npm run prices`; the run prints the store it actually used.

woolworths.comment: Woolworths prices are largely national. If you want Prahran-specific pricing, set storeId to the numeric fulfilment id (the run logs the store the API returns). Leave blank for default.

coles.comment: Coles search pricing is national; a store id is usually not needed. Leave blank unless a run shows otherwise.

aldi.comment: ALDI is national pricing; only a limited online range is listed.

iga.storeName: IGA Local Grocer Windsor (30 Chapel St)
iga.comment: IGA is per-store on igashop.com.au. Open igashop.com.au, choose your Windsor store, then copy the store's shop URL (e.g. https://www.igashop.com.au/store/<slug> or the URL after selecting the store) and paste it here as storeUrl. The adapter drives that page and captures the real product API responses (no endpoint guessing).
